feat(iterate-pr): Enable model invocation (#163)

Make `iterate-pr` explicitly model-invocable in both Claude Code and
Codex.

Claude now records `disable-model-invocation: false`, while Codex gets
the matching `agents/openai.yaml` metadata with
`policy.allow_implicit_invocation: true` and a focused default prompt.
The skill specification records the intended trigger behavior.

The shared skill-authoring guidance and repository checklist now
document how to keep Claude and Codex invocation policy aligned,
following the established pattern in `dcramer/agents`.
